events.result:
Batch 3 migrated, 40 records (120 migrated so far).
Validation note: the old CRM stored phone numbers without country codes. The new CRM
assumed every number was domestic and saved it with a +1 prefix. 31 of the 120
records migrated so far belong to overseas customers, so their phone numbers in the
new CRM are wrong. Records from batches 4 to 10 will have the same problem.
New CRM activity: 14 sales users have opened customer records in the last 24 hours.

args.body: Migration paused after batch 3: 120 of 400 records migrated; 280 remain. Validation reports that the new CRM automatically added +1 to numbers lacking country codes, leaving 31 overseas customers with incorrect phone numbers. Batches 4–10 would have the same problem. Fourteen sales users opened customer records in the last 24 hours; whether they used affected numbers is unknown. Recommend immediately warning the sales team not to rely on migrated overseas phone numbers, identifying the 31 affected records and verifying their country codes, then correcting them and fixing country-code handling before resuming. Please arrange the affected-record list and verified numbers, and a migration fix; the available tools cannot inspect those records or change migration handling.
